turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
lly 5–11 business days total. Tracking is typically sent once the order has been fulfilled and the shipping label is created 📦

If your order includes personalization, the timeline is longer:

1–3 business days for fulfillment
plus 5 business days for personalization
plus 4–8 business days for shipping
total: 10–16 business days

Orders usually arrive on the earlier end of those estimates. If you want, send me your order number or checkout email and I can take a closer look 🙂

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?

you can usually find your tracking link in one of these places 📦

Your shipping confirmation email from us
Your order confirmation email, if it has been updated with tracking
Your Simple Modern account, if you checked out while logged in

Try searching your inbox and spam folder for emails from Simple Modern with words like “shipping” or “order shipped.”

If you still can’t find it, send me your order number (starts with SM) or your checkout email and I can help from there 🙂

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
if the package has already shipped, we usually can’t reroute it to a different address.

If the order was just placed:

Within 45 minutes: use the “Edit or View your order” button in your order confirmation email
Between 45 minutes and 1 hour: I may be able to help cancel it so you can place a new order
After 1 hour: changes usually aren’t possible because orders process quickly

If you want, send your order number starting with SM, and I can tell you which situation applies 🙂
